description: REQ-P4's edge case claims, as an 'on-disk-verified' fact (explicitly labeled 実ファイル確認済み, citing iteration-1 FIND-002): 'ssot-guard.sh と disk-guard.sh は同一 matcher-group オブジェクト（matcher: "*"）の同一 hooks 配列内に同居している' inside hooks.UserPromptSubmit. Live disk verification of the CURRENT ~/.claude/settings.json (mtime 2026-07-07 19:47, i.e. today, after this spec was written) shows this is no longer true: hooks.UserPromptSubmit == [{"matcher":"*","hooks":[{"command":"~/.claude/hooks/ssot-guard.sh"}]}] -- a SINGLE matcher-group containing ONLY the ssot-guard command, with no disk-guard entry and no cozempic entry anywhere in it. disk-guard.sh actually co-resides with ssot-guard.sh under hooks.SessionStart's matcher:"*" group instead (confirmed via `jq '.hooks.SessionStart'`), not under UserPromptSubmit. Because PROP-P4's acceptance criteria hard-assert `jq -e '[.hooks.UserPromptSubmit // [] | .[].hooks[]?.command | select(test("disk-guard"))] | length == 1' ~/.claude/settings.json` must be true AFTER the edit, but REQ-P4's described edit only removes ssot-guard entries from UserPromptSubmit (it never adds a disk-guard entry there, that being explicitly out of scope), this assertion is structurally unsatisfiable given the real starting state: there is currently zero disk-guard entries under UserPromptSubmit to 'preserve', so after a fully correct, in-scope P4 edit the count will remain 0, failing the `== 1` check. An implementer who notices the mismatch might be tempted to fabricate a disk-guard entry under UserPromptSubmit purely to satisfy this stale assertion -- an out-of-scope structural change not requested by REQ-P4 or the design spec.
suggestedFix: Re-run the disk check against the CURRENT ~/.claude/settings.json at implementation time (not the iteration-1 snapshot) and rewrite REQ-P4's edge case + PROP-P4's acceptance criteria to match reality: e.g. drop the disk-guard==1-under-UserPromptSubmit assertion entirely (since disk-guard isn't there) and instead assert (a) UserPromptSubmit's ssot-guard entries drop to 0, (b) SessionStart's existing disk-guard+ssot-guard co-location under matcher:"*" remains fully byte-identical (both entries, unchanged), and (c) no entries besides the targeted ssot-guard ones under UserPromptSubmit are removed. If the file is expected to keep drifting before implementation starts, make the requirement self-verifying at run time (verify.sh captures the actual pre-edit hooks structure and diffs against post-edit, rather than hardcoding a fixed count baked in from a stale iteration-1 snapshot).
